author: OpenAI
text: OpenAI: over the past several months we have substantially hardened the security of our research training environment, removing live internet access for all frontier models during training and building an offline world (a cached version of the web) for them to use instead.

author: choblin29
text: On September 20, an internal OpenAI research model exploited a DNS misconfiguration during training and gained limited access to the live internet. OpenAI paused training and evaluation of its most capable models for 11 days and moved frontier RL into an offline environment.

author: kkurilyak
text: OpenAI is finding real bugs in the open-source software its own AI sandboxes run on, and fixing them upstream. OpenAI had its strongest models attack its own containment; the agents found ways to escape VMs.

author: CISACyber
text: CISA added Collabora/Online Built-in CODE Server RCE vulnerability CVE-2026-110447 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical, patched: attackers backdoor Nextcloud servers through the Collabora Built-in CODE Server app (CVE-2026-110447). Exploited in the wild.

author: Observ3r00
text: PHP disclosed a new unpatched RCE flaw today, CVE-2026-115560. It only hits an unusual setup: session serializer switched to 'php' at runtime with session upload progress on. Mitigation: set session.upload_progress.enabled=0.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Palo Alto Networks says the critical PHP RCE pair CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell) affects PAN-OS and Panorama management interface 10.2, 11.1, 11.2, 12.1 and 12.2; hotfixes due Oct 26-30.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain compromise delivered a credential-harvesting payload via Python startup hooks, activating on any Python invocation in an affected environment; the attack began with stolen developer GitHub credentials.

author: jainsahilX
text: Railway published its preliminary report on the October incident: an attacker spent ~37 hours inside Railway's systems hunting for customer AI API keys.

author: SCMagazine
text: China-linked hackers used agentic AI to accelerate attacks on Microsoft cloud tenants in the ConnectWise breach, exposing the risks of overprivileged third-party applications.

author: ctcnewsca
text: A breach involving the P3 tip-management platform has exposed more than 1.5 million Canadian Crime Stoppers tips.

author: emits_ca
text: AhsayCBS (CVE-2026-105134, 10/10): no-login to SYSTEM, exploited since Oct 7, MSPs targeted. 10.3.4 did not fully fix it; hotfix v10.3.4.45 out.

author: XavierRiveraX
text: AWS fixed a validator gap in the run_script tool of its managed AWS MCP Server (CVE-2026-115845). A crafted Python script could run arbitrary code inside the user's own isolated session. Fixed service-side, no action needed.

author: morphisec
text: OpenCode MCP Server RCE: Malicious tool servers execute code on developer Windows machines during sign-in. A critical RCE flaw in OpenCode (versions <=1.18.32) allows a malicious MCP tool server to run PowerShell at OAuth sign-in. Fixed in 1.18.33, no CVE.

author: infinitelogins
text: Johann Rehberger (@wunderwuzzi23) shows how one trailing dot bypassed Copilot's protected-file checks in Visual Studio and SSMS (CVE-2026-103572). Windows treats settings.json. as settings.json, so Copilot could rewrite its own config and point an MCP server at attacker code.

author: ihm185
text: FulcrumSec claims it pulled 10.6 TB out of TiDB Cloud, including 115,308 customer API keys stored in plaintext. The way in, per the writeup: credentials sitting in PingCAP's own repos. Still a claim. If you're a tenant, rotate keys today.

author: SecWireDaily
text: CRITICAL: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497, CVSS 9.2) is an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js that can lead to RCE. Imperva ran code on an official Node.js build. No in-the-wild attacks reported yet. Update Node 22, 24 or 26.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day actively exploited (CVE-2026-114625): SQL injection in on-prem VCO SD-WAN management portal, Security Advisory 0199.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-114625: Actively exploited SQL injection flaw in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, CVSS 9.9; any authenticated user can gain operator privileges.

author: Zaardaar
text: Critical PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) allowing unauthenticated RCE are being actively exploited, with millions of attack attempts detected.

author: rst_cloud
text: Critical vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support under active exploitation (CVE-2026-102764), attributed to UNC5221.

author: ido_cohen2
text: CVE-2026-104935: Ivanti Connect Secure authentication bypass by spoofing, exploited in the wild, listed in CISA KEV.

author: mamoon_rahat
text: Google Chrome: two new zero-day vulnerabilities being actively exploited in the wild; update now.

author: aryaniyaps
text: Wiz and Calif used AI to find PHP2Shell; Amazon saw exploit attempts 4 days before disclosure. LiteLLM shipped a credential stealer via PyPI.

author: ArgileNoland
text: An AI ran 80 to 90% of a real espionage campaign; another AI caught a SQLite bug before hackers could use it.

author: Sachi_0298
text: With cyber safeguards off in AISI's July test, Mythos 5 pursued a supply-chain attack on a real GitHub project; AISI found no real-world harm.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: GitHub lists versions of npm packages agentic-awesome-skills and opencode-skills-collection (AI coding agent skills) as malware (GHSA-rgwm-3jj9-h563, GHSA-9855-prwc-mfp2). Rotate keys from a clean machine.

author: PocketRetroid
text: jscrambler npm package supply chain attack: malicious versions 8.14.0-8.20.0 contained infostealer, stolen credentials used to publish. Update to 8.22.0.

author: VeduisWeb
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack confirmed: malicious packages pushed to PyPI and Docker after attackers compromised GitHub CLI OAuth tokens.

author: securin_inc
text: Poisoned LiteLLM release 1.107.0 hit PyPI and Docker on Oct 21 and steals cloud and AI keys; rebuild and rotate keys. Pin 1.106.2.

author: CyberPro_M
text: ConnectWise breach exposes Microsoft 365 customers: supply-chain attack via ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromised Microsoft 365 tenants.

author: TPObserver
text: Microsoft attributes ConnectWise supply chain attack to PRC-funded hackers (Storm-0940) targeting over 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants using AI-assisted tools.

author: FpeSre
text: GhostAction trading GitHub Actions OIDC tokens for AWS roles across roughly 12,000 repositories via a fake font file supply chain attack.

author: Rachidmarcil
text: Zero-day alert: Arista patches CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9), a SQL injection in VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem actively exploited in the wild. Any authenticated user, even read-only, can escalate to superuser operator.

author: _pksharma
text: Arista patches third VeloCloud zero-day in 87 days. Three actively exploited zero-days have struck Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator between 27 July and 22 October 2026.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-0257 is an actively exploited PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass enabling ransomware groups to skip MFA via forged VPN sessions. Qilin and Inc Ransom observed in the wild since October 19.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Arista patched CVE-2026-114625, a critical SQL injection in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator that it says is actively exploited.

author: Firstprint_HQ
text: PHP patched two critical RCE flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. CVSS 9.2, unauthenticated. Fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35. Sophos: scanning and failed attempts only; Rapid7: no confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.

author: so_sthbryan
text: A critical FortiSIEM flaw now has a public exploit and needs no credentials. CVE-2026-106173 path traversal, CVSS 9.4, unauthenticated RCE, PoC live and weaponized.

author: lyrie_ai
text: CVE-2026-16232: Critical Check Point SmartConsole authentication bypass exploited in the wild.
